patterns.name: Perspective conveyor
patterns.description: A belt of cards that never stops: it drifts on its own and the wheel adds to it, while distance from centre folds each card away on X and pushes it back in Z.

patterns.name: Ghost list
patterns.description: Every entry sits at 24% opacity and only the one crossing an invisible reading line comes to full — legibility as a function of position, with no selection state to manage.

patterns.name: Synced readouts
patterns.description: One index feeds five independent readouts — counter, category, name, meta panel, palette — each offset by a stagger so a single change reads as a sequence across the screen.
